tei:div.tei:p: !! dpe thog bro brdung go skam gyi snang tshul sogs gang dran yi ger btab pa rang mtshangs ston pa'i glu chung nam mkha'i me tog gzhon nu'i lding khang zhes bya ba mchis so// na mo gu ru badz+ra dhā ra bh+yaḥ mi 'gyur bde stong phyag rgya chen po'i dbyings// srid zhi mnyam sbyor ye shes rdo rje'i gar// du mar bsgyur bas 'gro rgyud smin grol cher// 'god mdzad rdo rje can zhabs pad+mor 'dud// de yang skal bzang rnams 'dren bzhi pa rgyal ba nyi ma'i gnyen mchog gi dpal gyi mgul nas seng ge'i sgra chen pos/ mdo sde rnams su lan gcig ma yin par bsngags pa'i dril bsgrags shing*/ dpa' bo chen por lung bstan pa/ dus gsum du ma byung*/ mi 'byung*/ 'byung bar mi 'gyur ba'i skyes bu khyu mchog /mkhas pa'i gtso bo/ grub pa'i yang rtse/ bstan pa yongs rdzogs kyi mnga' bdag bka' brgyud rdo rje 'chang gi rgyal srid dam par dbang 'byor pa'i rje btsun chen po/ gang gi bka' drin gyi mtha' gzhal du med cing*/ rdo rje mtshan nas shin tu yang brjod par dka' ba de nyid kyis brtse ba chen pos yun ring por bskyangs pa'i 'bangs/ ngan bu bdag la bka' brgyud kyi gral mtha' zin pa'i yon tan gyi dngos po shin tu dbul por gyur mod kyang*/ rang gi go nyams dang bstun pa'i rtogs 'bul zhu 'phrin gyi glu chung rkang drug gzhon nu'i ldings dbyangs su phul ba ni/ na mo gu ru gu ṇa sā ga ra ye/ gzhi gdod ma'i sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang*// gdangs ma 'gag snying rje chen po'i sku// sangs rgyas lag bcangs su gtod pa'i sku drin can// mi bdag gi spyi gtsug rgyan du rol// dus lan gcig mi lus thob pa bdag /thugs brtse ba chen pos rjes bzungs te// dal 'byor don ldan du mdzad pa'i rje btsun khyed// 'bral med du snying dbus thig ler bzhugs// bus mos shing gdung bas gsol ba 'debs// phas thugs rjes gzigs shig rin po che// rje khyed kyi thugs rje'i 'od zer gyis// bdag ngar 'dzin 'khrul pa'i mun bsal nas// don yang dag gnas lugs rtogs pa'i glu// tshig col chung sbrang bu'i rjes 'gro can// pha rje btsun snyan la gzan lags kyang*// bu mi bzod gdung bas gya gyu'i tshig

/glu mchod par 'bul lo brtse bas dgongs// spyir dal brgyad 'byor bcu ldan pa'i lus// yid bzhin gyi nor bu las lhag pa// 'di thob pa phyin ci ma log pa'i// bsod nams kyi mthu btsan yin par shes// de thob kyang rtag pa ma yin phyir// dus 'chi ba zer ba'i bzlog med pa// kho nam 'ong nges shes ma rnyed pas// 'chi ba de bdag la nam 'ong snyam// las rgyu 'bras bslu med so sor smin// dpe sa bon btab pa ji bzhin te// rang gzhan mgo bskor gyi bya ba 'dis// dus tha ma'i tshe na ci 'dra snyam// lar ma rig 'khor ba'i grong khyer che// mtha' med dos drag gi sdug bsngal can// 'di bsam na yid dbang 'chor 'dra ba'i// 'jigs skrag gis gzir te nam thar snyams// las ngan pa'i rlung gis bskyod pa'i lus// lam log pa'i g.yang las brdeg 'chos pas// da 'khor ba'i 'dam du byings der gzigs// rje drin can bla ma rin po ches// bdag 'jigs pa 'di las bskyab tu gsol// las ngan pa'i 'phro nas bzang po rnyed// pha rje btsun don gyi sangs rgyas mchog /dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i ngo bor mjal// bdag mi shes ngar 'dzin gyi shun pa bud// chags sdang gis 'ching ba'i rgya mdud grol// dus gsum gyis bskyed pa'i nyon mongs pa// 'di skye yul skye bya skyed mkhan gsum// thams cad rang sems kyi snang cha ste// dpe me long nang gi gzugs brnyan bzhin// rang nyid kyi ngo bo stong pas na// rgya mtsho la chu rlabs thim pa bzhin// brjod med stong pa'i dbyings su yal// phyi yul snang gzugs sgra dri ro reg /snang ba kun sems kyi cho 'phrul las// don logs su grub pa ma mchis pa// dpe byis pas mkhar las byas pa bzhin// ming mtshan mar 'dzin mkhan rang gi sems// de bden med rtogs pa'ang rang gi sems// don de phyir logs su grub pa dang*// gzugs mtshan mar gnas pa ma dmigs te// rang sems kyi rig rtsal yin par rtogs// lar 'khor ba dang mya ngan 'das pa zhes// gnas so so dang bzang ngan mi gda' bar// sems chos sku'i rig rtsal nyid du rtogs// don rang byung sems kyi gnas lugs de// gzugs dang rdzas su ma grub cing*// dpe yis mtshon pa'ang yongs su bral// stong zhes med pa ma yin te// rang bzhin gyi ni 'od gsal ba// kun la khyab pa'i nam mkha' bzhin// yod ces dngos por ma grub ste// nam mkha' gzugs su ji lta bar// grub pa med la rab tu gsal// gsal ba de las thams cad skyes// skyes pa'ang logs su ma grub par// gsal ba de yi ngo bor grol// nam mkha' la ni sprin ji bzhin// klong nas shar zhing klong du thim// mdor na snang srid rang gi sems// gsal ba'i cha las snang ba dang*// ngo bo'i cha las stong pa ste// logs su mtshan mar grub pa yi// sangs rgyas med cing sems can med// lha dang 'dre zhes yongs ma grub// thams cad rang bzhin sems nyid de// de ni rang byung 'od gsal ba// skye 'gags dmigs pa kun las 'das// gang du gnas dang 'gro 'ong bral// brjod du med pa'i rang gi sems// 'di las gzhan pa'i rdo rje 'chang*// ma grub sems nyid 'od gsal ba// yin par rtogs pa'i gdengs shig shar// 'di rtogs pa rje btsun khyed kyi drin// da bka' drin dran no rin po che// las ngan can bdag la thugs rjes gzigs// pha rje btsun don gyi rdo rje 'chang*// dus yang yang dran cing mos gus 'bar// yengs med kyi gdung bas gsol ba 'debs// phas 'du 'bral med par byin gyis rlobs// de skad rang nyams su shar ba'i glu// pha rje btsun khyed kyi snyan la 'bul// don 'khrul pa'i dri ma mchis gyur na// thugs byams pa'i bdud rtsis bkru bar gsol// bus rtse gcig gdung bas gsol 'debs na// phas thugs rje'i lcags kyus bzung du gsol// ces sangs rgyas karma pa'i chos kyi pho brang chen po 'og min karma'i gtsug lag khang nas/

rnam 'gyur zhes pa lcags khams 'dzum drug bkra ba'i lor kun mkhyen rje btsun chos kyi rgyal po'i zhabs drung du sgo gsum gus pa chen pos phul ba'o// ༈ rang la gros 'debs pa dang*/ bla ma'i thugs rje bskul ba'i gsol 'debs mos gus gdung dbyangs ces bya ba/ kye lags/ skyabs sangs rgyas kun 'dus rje btsun khyed// sngon grangs med gong nas sangs rgyas kyang*// mar 'khor bar 'khyams rnams 'dren pa'i phyir// mi gzugs su byon pa'i bka' drin can// pha bla ma thugs rje'i gter chen mkhyen// rgyud chos dang 'dres par byin gyis rlobs// dus snyigs ma lnga bdo'i mar gsham 'dir// tshe long med bar snang glog dang mtshungs// nor mi rtag rtswa kha'i zil pa 'dra// grogs da nang 'dza' yang don nub 'khon// 'di kun kyang mdang gi rmi lam 'dra// lar cis kyang mi rtag 'pho zhing 'gyur// da rtag 'dzin gyi zhen pa skyur la thongs// pha bla ma mkhyen no thugs rjes gzigs// sgrub brgyud kyi bstan pa'i sgor zhugs shing*// chos sdom pa gsum gyis rgyud sbyangs kyang*// rgya mtsho yi 'gram na yi dwags bzhin// ris chad kyi blo rgyud dred po 'di// ci byas kyang chos brgyad kyi dbang du thal// mi phung bdag brlag gi chos spyod mkhan// phyi sa gos bzang gis g.yogs dang mtshungs// da rang mtshang 'byin pa'i dus la bab// rje bla ma mkhyen no thugs rjes gzigs// lus ngur smrig gyon kyang tha mal pa// ming byang sems btags kyang chags sdang can// sngags zab mor zhugs kyang lta spyod log /nges 'byung gi blo rgyud ma thul zhing*// las 'bras la yid ches ma rnyed pas// dam sdom rnams go ba'i yul du lus// dgra 'dul dang gnyen skyongs gsog 'jog sogs// don med kyi 'du 'dzis bran du bkol// bde gshegs kyi bka' dang 'gal bzhin du// sangs rgyas kyi rjes 'jug tu rlom sems can// bdud nyon mongs kyi khol por gyur pa yi// pha bka' brgyud kyi bu rul dred po bdag

/da rang tshul mthong tshe snying rlung ldang*// pha rje btsun mkhyen no thugs rjes gzigs// dus gsum du 'byon dka'i rje btsun mgon// bdag dmu rgod 'dul ba'i phrin las mkhan// sangs rgyas las lhag pa'i bka' drin can// drin can du ma shes a re 'khrul// chos gdams ngag brda' dang thabs kyis ston// de ma shes chos shig log nas btsal// yang dag pa'i chos skal de ru bcad// da ci mdzad legs par mthong re ran// sgo gsum 'di bla ma'i phyogs su bkal// bskal mang gi tshogs rdzogs sgrib kun 'byongs// 'di rang don du 'gyur ba ma shes te// rang don gyi dge sbyor 'bungs blo yis// dngos grub kyi 'bras bu sad la bskur// rgyud log ltas bcings pa ngo re gnongs// da ci gsung tshad mar bzung re ran// bdag mi bzod gdung bas gsol ba 'debs// phas thugs rjes gzigs la byin gyis rlobs// rje sangs rgyas su 'dug pa mi ru bzung*// thabs mkhas kyi phrin las skyon du mthong*// don chen gyi mdzad par log lta skyes// rang khong nas rul ba ma tshor zhing*// ri mo yi nang gi mar me bzhin// bcos ma'i dad pa la re ba khyod// da bzod med kyi mos gus shugs phyungs la// log lta yi 'dam nas la 'ur longs// bcos min dad pa'i rtsal nus sprugs// dag snang gi sman dpyad brten re ran// snying rus pa'i khung nas gsol ba 'debs// phas thugs rjes gzigs la byin gyis rlobs// dgra 'chi bdag zer ba'i g.yer chen kho// drung 'di na sleb dus 'gyod pa phyis// chos pa yi mal nas tha mal ro// mi drag zhan kun gyis 'phya zhing khrel// rang gtad med 'khor bar 'khyams dus 'byung*// 'di bsam zhing rig pa'i rno ngar bskyed// snang srid kun bla ma'i rol par ltos// rang sems 'di rje yi thugs dang bsres// dbyer med kyi ngang nas gsol ba thob// mos gus kyi gdungs dbyangs lhang lhang gis// skyabs bslu med thugs rje'i rgyud bskul nas// rang sems kyi ngo bo skyong re ran// bdag bzod med snying nas gsol ba 'debs// phas thugs rjes gzigs la byin gyis rlobs// gnyis 'dzin gyi rtog pas ma bslad na// sangs rgyas su grags pa'i g.yer po che// sems rang gsal 'di las gud na med// blos byas kyi rdzun bsgom bor la zhog

/byar med kyi rang zhal lta re ran// bdag mos gus gdung bas gsol ba 'debs// phas thugs rjes gzigs la byin gyis rlobs// lar 'khor 'das dang bde sdug snang cha 'di// thams cad kun bla ma rje yi drin// bde ba dang dge ba ji snyed pa// mgon rdo rje sems dpa' pha 'babs lags// de ma rgan yongs la bgo bshar byos// tshogs gnyis kyi rten 'brel rgyan du che// dga' brod kyi 'dzin pas ma bcings par// bde stong zung 'jug gi nyams len ngang*// yid mos gus gdung bas gsol ba 'debs// phas thugs rjes gzigs la byin gyis rlobs// sdug bsngal dang mi 'dod ji snyed kun// rje bla ma'i thugs rje'i phrin las te// ma 'gro drug gi sdug bsngal dang du longs// sgrib sbyong gi gdams ngag ye shes me// sdug bsngal rang bzhin ma grub pa'i// tshor stong zung 'jug gi nyams len ngang*// yid rtse gcig gdung bas gsol ba 'debs// phas thugs rjes gzigs la byin gyis rlobs// lar gang shar gyi 'khrul rjes mi 'brengs par// snang stong zung 'jug gi ngang la zhog /gzhi med rtsa bral gyi ngo bor ltos// blta bya dang lta byed gnyis stong zhing*// gnyis med kha sbyor gyi bar lag na// ye gdod kyi gnas lugs ltad mo che// don rang rig bla ma'i rang zhal mjal// bde chen gyi rgyal sa zin par nges// de'i phyir na dad med kyi snying sran can// khyod ma yengs rgyun du gsol ba thob// dgos med kyi bya ba bor la thongs// pha mkhyen no de dus gsum mkhyen pa mkhyen// ci mdzad khyed shes kyi blo gtad dang*// nyin mtshan dus drug tu gdungs dbyangs bcas// bus rtse gcig gdung bas gsol ba 'debs// phas thugs rjes gzigs la byin gyis rlobs// bcos min gyi mos gus 'bar ba dang*// rtogs grol dus mnyam gyi ye shes spor// 'gro don lhun grub kyi rten 'brel bsgrig

/rje khyed dang dbyer med mdzad du gsol// zhes pa'ang sgrub brtson bla ma karma rgyal dbang nas/ bkra shis pa'i dar dang*/ rin chen gnyis pa'i snang gsal gyi kong bu bcas/ bcos min gyi mos gus skye ba'i gsol 'debs shig bris shig par bskul ba na/ grub thob gong ma'i gsung las lhag pa'i gsol 'debs ma mchis shing*/ dman pa bdag lta bus sbyar ba ngal ba tsam las snying pos dben kyang*/ bskul ba po'i ngo mi ldog tsam du rang nyid la gros 'debs pa dang*/ skal mnyam gzhan la'ang rgyud 'chos shing*/ mos gus 'phel ba'i rkyen du gyur na ci ma rung snyam nas/ dus zhabs kyi slob dpon du khas che ba mkha' khyab rdo rjes zhes bya ba'i snyom las mkhan des gang dran yi ge'i phreng bar spel ba'o/// /re ltos bla ma las med par blo thag chod cing snyigs dus kyi spyod 'gros las yid skyo ba'i gdung shugs kyis phyung ba'i dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs blang dor gsal ba'i me long zhes bya ba ni/ rje bka' drin mnyam med bla ma rje// dpal rdo rje 'chang chen g.yer po che// yongs rgyal ba'i phrin las karma pa// dpal mkha' khyab rdo rje ma lags sam// bu mos pa'i blo yis 'o dod 'bod// pha rje btsun snyan gyis gsan lags sam// mtho srid rtse nas bzung dmyal khams bar// sdug bsngal gyis mnar ba'i 'gro tshogs la// thugs brtse ba'i spyan gyis gzigs su gsol// spyir 'khor ba'i gnas la bde ba med// dgos snyigs ma lnga bdo'i 'gro ba rnams// las nag po sdig la ngom med spyod// blo mi mthun gcig sems gcig la sdang*// byams pha ma yin kyang dmar bsad byed// las ngo lkogs mi thub rang snang mtho// tshe phyi mar phan pa'i sham ra ci// 'phral bya ba'ang phug 'dun til tsam med// tshul gang la bsams kyang skyo ba skyes// spyir 'khor ba'i chos la yid brtan med// dgos deng sang tshul la yid re skyo// lus mi rtag 'byung bzhi rgud cing 'gro// dgra 'chi bdag zhags pas ske la thebs// 'phral rnam g.yeng bya bas blo sna khrid// dus lo zla zhag gis rgyab nas 'phul// las dkar nag bya bas mdun nas bsus// da ci ltar byas kyang tshe 'dis g.yeng*// blo chos su ma song chos pa'i gsob// mi gzhan gyis skyabs gnas mchog tu rtsi// de skyob pa'i nus pa bdag la med// gshin gson gyi dad zas bag med spyod// 'du 'god kyi shom ras nyin mtshan 'da'// las byas pa don yod gcig kyang med// da bsam bzhin rang la yi mug skye// gzhon dbang po gsar pa'i lang tsho yang*// rgas mi sdug ba mo'i sad kyis bcom// lus 'du ba 'khrugs pa'i nad kyis mnar// dus yun ring 'dug blo'i rtag 'dzin mkhan// mi bdag la bla mas thugs rjes gzigs// tshur nyon dang rgan bu dpal ldan pa// da byed na dge ba'i bya ba gyis// blo sham na phyi ma'i don la shoms// bka' mdo rgyud rgya che 'byams klas pa'i// tshul legs par rtogs pa'i yang dag chos// las skal dman khyod kyi spyod yul min// blo pher yongs lugs gnyis bstan pa'i khur// khyod 'dra bas 'grub rgyu ga la yod// gnas nges med dben pa'i ri ngog tu// blo gtad med gu yangs gyis dang legs// nor 'dzad med chog shes snying po'i dbyig

/stor med kyi bang mdzod bkang dang dge /dgra dug lnga yan par ma btang zhig /pha bla mas gtsug tu rgyan na mdzes// las zin med brel dos ma g.yeng par// sos dal du khregs se bzhag na dga'// dbu phyag dang rdzogs chen grags pa de// sdug khyod kyis gnad gsang ga la rtogs// sdug u tshug ma byed nyal na 'thad// bod gangs ljongs skal dman 'gro ba'i skyabs// lha thugs rje chen por gsol ba thob// gsung yig drug skul ba'i glu chung longs// lus tha mal ma bzhag lha ru sgoms// yid 'gyur dran rang grol gtad med thong*// ma 'gro la brtse ba'i byang sems sgoms// rang gzhan gyi mgo skor 'chad spel skyur// mi gzhan kyi ngo srung mi re bar// gong dpon med byed na mi legs sam// 'gu med kyi skyong dran sems las che// 'og 'khor g.yog spang na legs sam snyam// tshul ji ltar byas kyang bde ba med// da gang byung des chog yid la zhogs// skyabs bslu ba med pa'i dkon mchog mchog /yongs gcig 'dus dpal ldan bla ma la// phugs 'phral gang gnyis kyi blo gtad zhu// sprang skyid sdug ci byung bla ma mkhyen// 'bangs bdag la re sa gzhan na med// pha thugs rjes gzigs shig karma pa// ces 'jam mgon chos kyi rgyal po'i mtshan kyi cod paṇa 'chang ba karma dpal ldan mkhyen brtse'i 'od zer du 'bod pa'i snyom las pas gang dran thol byung du bris pa'o// rigs kun khyab bdag dang po'i sangs rgyas mchog /dpal ldan bla ma 'bral med snying dbus bsnyen// rgyal mchog gang gi 'bangs mthar snyegs pa yi// snyom las chos gzugs 'du shes gsum pa la// bong ba gser gzigs rjes brtses rigs bdag tu// bzhes pa 'di ko e ma sngon smon mthu// 'bad pa ma yin lhun 'grub rten 'brel rmad// gang gi bka' bzang spyi gtsug rgyan nyid du// blangs nas sems don rtogs pa'i glu chung 'di// 'phags mchog dgyes pa'i rol mor mchod pa 'bul// dang por mi rtag sdug bsngal 'dus byas chos// snying po med pa'i bsam pa khongs nas shar// bar du yang dag lam du rab zhugs nas// 'khor ba spang dang myang 'das blang byar go

/da lta 'khor 'das mnyam pa'i gdings shig rnyed// chos rnams thams cad ye shes chos sku'i rtsal// rig dang ma rig so mtshams skad cig ma// 'khrul grol kun gyi rtsa bar rang gi sems// da lta'i shes pa spang bsgyur bzo ma bcos// rang 'babs rang gnas stong gsal ma 'gags pa// phyi snang ma lus nang du 'dzin sems stong*// snang dang stong pa gnyis su dbye ba bral// zung 'jug tshig gis mi mtshon blo las 'das// mtha' bral ming brgyas mtshon pa'i gnas lugs don// bskyed rdzogs mdo sngags thabs brgyas gnyer bya yi// sangs rgyas da lta'i sems las med par 'khums// mgon khyod ye gdod gong nas rdzogs sangs rgyas// nyams thag 'gro ba'i dpal du mi yi zol// rim bgrod lam gyi ngal bar ma ltos kyang*// tshul mthong snang ngor gdams ngag rnam thar du// ston phyir thugs dam rim 'khrungs tshul bstan kyang*// ro gcig chen po sgom med yar ldan nyams// nges par gzigs la rgan bu yi rangs shing*// dad gus spro bas thal mo snying gar zum// nyin mtshan dus kun bzo med mos gus dang*// lus rten 'di yis bstan pa'i don grub snyam// rdo rje 'chang dngos gang gi dgongs pa'i bcud// pha nor bu la phog pa'i nyams bzang la// bka' brgyud gser gyi phreng ba'i bzhugs gral du// ra gan gser du brdzu ba'i sel ma zhugs// phyogs dus rgyal bas dbyings nas mkhyen nam snyam// mkha' 'gro chos skyong rnams kyi spyan gyis gzigs// bdag kyang sgom med chos sku'i rgyal thabs cher// rang byung khyab bdag rig pa'i rdo rje'i ngang*// dbyer med thugs yid 'dres par thugs rjes zungs// dge bas rgyal bstan mdzes pa'i rgyan du shog /ces pa 'di bzhin/ rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen gzigs bcu drug pa chen po'i bka' lung gser gyi cod pan spyi bor bcings te rang gi rtogs tshad maṇ+ḍal du phul zhing mchog gi thugs dam sa mtshams dang gus 'bangs tha shal pa'ang*/

mgon po mchog gi dgongs klong ngang dbyer med pa'i smon tshig bcas bcos bsgyur med par rgyal sras 'jam mgon sprul skur 'bod pas shar mar bris te phul ba dgyes pa'i ye shes spyan gyi 'babs stegs su gyur cig// /

༄༅/ /na mo gu ru/ skyes bu chen po'i chen po/ dam pa'i dam par gyur cing gzod nas dus gsum rgyal ba'i yab nyid du gyur cing mngon par sangs rgyas zin na'ang*/ snyigs ma'i rmu rgod gdul dka' ba rnams kyi don du mchog gi sprul pa'i sku rdo rje slob dpon gyi gzugs su bzhengs shing bstan dang 'gro ba'i don rlabs po che khur du bzhes te/ chos dang chos ma yin pa'i don ma lus pa mkhyen cing gzigs pa sogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i yon tan gyi phung pos lci ba 'gro ba'i mgon po dpal ldan bla ma dam pa mtshan nas brjod par dka' ba/ dpal ldan rang byung rig pa'i ye shes lung rtogs chos kyi nyi ma phrin las don kun grub pa'i sde zhes bya bas rdo rje'i mgur gsungs pa ni/ de yang ngan bu bdag la bka' brgyud kyi bla ma rnams dang rjes su mthun pa'i yon tan cha shas tsam yang ma mthong mod 'on kyang dpal ldan bla ma dam pa'i gdams ngag gi mthu btsan pas de dag la nges pa cung zad re mi rnyed pa'i thabs dang bral ba'i skabs su rdo rje'i glu bla ma dang ḍā ki dgyes pa'i snyan 'gyur 'di phul ba'o// na mo gu ru/ pha bla ma rtsa gsum 'dus pa'i sku// bdag snying dbus tsit+ta'i dbyings rol na// dus 'bral med sku gsum gyi ngo bo la// dad gsum gyi mos gus skyes lags kyang*// rtag 'dzin gyi 'khrul ba'i 'khor lo 'dir// 'khor gsum gyi rtsa ba ma chod gda'// rgyu der brten bdag gzhan 'gro ba rnams// ma rig mun pa chen por 'thums// de sel ba'i thabs shig bla mas rtsol// dal 'byor bco brgyad kyi rten bzang 'di// chu bur bzhin mi rtag cha med par// yid ches kyang rmu rgod je cher gyur// pha bla ma khyed kyi thugs rje yis// bdag sems can ma rig 'khrul pa chod// las rgyu 'bras bslu med myong 'gyur chos// dge sdig gi blang dor so sor smin// de bsam zhing pha ma snying re rje// ma rig gis rtag 'dzin ther gzugs 'dir// ngas byas dang khos byas 'ching bzhin ngang*// dkar nag gi dbye 'byed brtson ra la// rang byas kun rang thog smin par nges// de bsam zhing ma rgan sems can rnams// rgyu 'bras kyi dbye 'byed go ma log

/dben gsum gyi zhing du dal sdod nas// lus ngag gi dge sbyor 'bung bar gyis// de byed na dpal ldan bla ma yi// thugs rje la nye ring yod ma yin// rgyu gcig la 'bras bu so so yi// gnad don gnyis bden pa rtogs dus su// khams gsum gyi sems can kun gyi ngo*// don de las 'gyur ba yod ma yin// rang rig gi ma bcos lhun rdzogs su// rang gsal gyis khams gsum rgya dkrol zhing*// rang blo yis ma bslad gnyug ma'i gshis// rang byung gi dbyings rol bla ma'i sku// stong gsal gyi mtha' la ma zhen par// sku bzhi yi ngo bor lhun grub nas// bla ma dang rang sems de la zer// gnad de yang ming du btags tsam las// mtha' gcig tu mtshon pa'i go skabs bral// don de las gdung ba'i sems bskyed kyis// ma khams gsum 'khor ba dongs nas dkrug /dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas stong rtsa gnyis// thugs dmigs med dam bca'i bden mthu yis// blo 'das kyi chos sku'i rgyal sa 'di// skad cig gis mngon du byed pa dang*// 'gro ba kun gnad 'dir sgrol bar shog /zhes dang*/ yang snyigs ma'i skye ba mi srun pa'i lta spyod la yid rab tu skyo ba dang 'brel pha gcig bla ma'i thugs bskyed rjes su bskul ba'i glu yid kyi gdung sel zhes bya ba/ a ho/ skyabs kun 'dus chos sku rdo rje 'chang*// don dbyer med dpal ldan bla ma'i sku// bdag bzod med gdung bas glu dbyangs 'di// sems bzod med mos gus kyi shugs las thal// gshis ye babs gsal dngas phyed pa 'di// babs zang thal ngang du mi yan par// blo 'gyu dran gyi rtog dpyod a re 'khrul// 'di bsam bzhin karma'i bka' brgyud dran// gzhi rig stong rang gnas thog tu bzlo// dus da lta'i tha mal shes pa 'di// skyes grol yid la mi byed par// gdangs 'gags med yul phyir mi dpyod kyang*// 'khor 'das kyi gnas snang gcig char snang*// lam rtsol med phyag chen rmad du byung*// gzhi rang gnas kyi rig pa rang zhal mjal// 'khor 'das kyi 'gros la rang byan tshud// khams gsum gyi 'khrul snang dbyings su dibs// sku gsum rang gnas kyi thog tu phebs// yid phyi smon gyi 'bras bu gang du byed// 'di bka' brgyud rnams kyi khyad chos lags// der bsam nas gong ma'i gshegs shul snyegs// mi bdag la ltos pa'i rjes 'jug rnams// tshe 'di la ma zhen phyi mar soms// phyi ngur smrig mtshams sprin rgyan gyis spras// nang sdom gsum gnang bkag ri bong rwa// lam rim gnyis 'di mi bsgom yid re skyo// sang 'chi ba'i dus la 'babs pa'i tshe// blo phyi 'gyod mun pas non nyan yod// don de phyir thos bsam bsgom par dril// sgrub bstan gyi rgyal mtshan srid rtser sgrengs// don gnyis ldan stan thog 'di ru mdzod// de 'grub pa'i mthun rkyen bla ma dang*// dpal ma mgon lcam dral tshogs bcas kyis// dus 'bral med re ba 'grub par mdzod// zhes pa 'di ni spyir bka' brgyud kyi lta sgom la yid ches kyi nges pa cung zad rnyed pa dang*/

chos gzugs chos bzhin ma byed pa rnams kyi spyod pa la'ang yid skyo bas rgyu byas/ ring mo zhig nas ngos kyi rje dbon dang*/ grub dpon bde chen sogs kyis 'di lta bu'i mgur zhig dgos zhes yang yang bskul ma byung ba ma zad/ deng skabs bka' brgyud gong ma rnams kyi mgur mtsho'i spar bskrun gsar du bkod pa'i rgyu rkyen phun tshogs skabs slar yang chos khrims bla ma sgrub brgyud bstan dar nas nan bskul gyi ngo ma ldog tsam du/ dpal karma pa'i skyes rabs 'dzin pa bcu drug pas gang shar thol byung du smras pa'o/// /maṅga laṃ//
